# IT System Optimization and Monitoring Guidelines

This document details essential tasks for maintaining and improving the bank's IT infrastructure.

*   Optimize the firewall settings quarterly.
*   Monitor the firewall settings quarterly.
*   Optimize the database migration standard update.
*   Monitor the API latency based on audit.
*   Investigate the API latency quarterly.
